launch_slurm_job: submit a SLURM job using submitit AutoExecutor with the given DictConfig and log directory
launch_local_job: launch a local distributed job using torch elastic or single process with the given config
run_slurm_spmd_program: run a SPMD program entrypoint on SLURM that sets up distributed backend and executes a runner
map_job_config_to_dist_config: convert a JobConfig into a distributed configuration dictionary with world size and backend settings
remove_runner_state_from_submission: decouple a submitted job from runner state by modifying the pickled submission object
